snippet.title: Session: Skate Sim - Official Abandoned Mall DLC Trailer
snippet.description: Take a tour of the new map called Abandoned Mall in this latest trailer for Session: Skate Sim. The new map is situated in an abandoned shopping mall where nature is reclaiming its territory. The Abandoned Mall DLC for Session: Skate Sim is available now. The DLC features the Abandoned Mall map and 38 items for the object dropper.
